- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Golf courses, such as Kultaranta Golf on an island in the archipelago, are available for enthusiasts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Camping spots are plentiful in and around Turku, including on the islands of the archipelago.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fishing opportunities exist in lakes, rivers, and the sea around Turku.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sailing is popular, with several yacht clubs and marinas in Turku.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Outdoor festivals, such as the Turku Music Festival and the Medieval Market, are hosted throughout the summer.
